name: John Shakespeare
original_name: ジョン・シェイクスピア
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c87048]Will's[/url] blind father and the de-facto owner of their pub, though he is no longer able to work. He spends his day chatting with the customers and begging Will for booze. He hosts secret Catholic meetings in the now very anti-Catholic Tenbridge.
